email_draft.subject: Yvonne, North Cascade's 2,030 IEPs tracked faster | Journify
email_draft.body:
Yvonne, you commented on our progress-monitoring post on April 18, and given your role overseeing student support services at North Cascade, that comment stood out.

At roughly 2,030 IEPs, collecting timely goal-progress data across teachers, paraprofessionals, speech-language pathologists, and OT/PT staff is a coordination problem as much as a documentation one. Journify sits on top of SEIS, so your team logs progress, generates present-levels narratives, and keeps IEP materials current without touching the system they already know. Teachers report saving more than four hours per day on that paperwork, which means your case managers and therapists spend afternoons running sessions instead of writing them up.

Open to a 20-minute walk-through this Thursday or Friday?
